title: Incredible Design!
body:
Most beautiful, useful, and life-changing app ever.

They certainly made it obvious to use, attractive, easy, and satisfying!
author: walt.f

title: Great app, but expensive
body:
I believe the app is amazing as it is something ideated by James, who I personally admire and beieve to be a great mind.

However, the app is too expensive given what it offers. I’d be more than happy to pay 3-5 bucks per month but 12 is a lot given the amount of other apps in the same area.
